name: 密集补水六件套水乳套装款

category.leaf: 六件套补水保湿水乳套装

description: 洁面到眼周六件套全线补水保湿，水润通透一整套护肤流程

styleLock.backgroundSystem: light aqua #CDEDEA for hero and infographic shots, pure white #FFFFFF for packshot, pain-point and trust shots, soft water-ripple accents only
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft cool-toned studio lighting, front or front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, water-fresh clean mood
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth light aqua panel #CDEDEA and neutral light aqua-beige counter #E8F1EF
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal #1F6E6B, all copy wrapped in 「」; mint-green #56C2A8 reserved for thin-line icons and accent rules, not for body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and translucent rounded bubbles in one accent color #56C2A8
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product group arrangement, consistent scale across the set, hero pieces centered and upright, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh hydrating skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of light aqua background #CDEDEA, pure white #FFFFFF, deep teal text #1F6E6B and one mint-green accent #56C2A8; bright soft cool-toned studio lighting with front or front-left key, gentle fill, soft contact shadows and a water-fresh clean mood; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #1F6E6B with all copy wrapped in 「」; consistent translucent rounded info labels and thin-line icons; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal water-ripple infographic elements; stable product group arrangement and consistent scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 整套产品配水花冲击力开场，一秒建立水润印象并赢取点击
shots.camera: group shot at a slight 3/4 angle, eye-level, all pieces fully visible and upright
shots.lighting: bright soft cool-toned studio lighting, front key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows
shots.background: light aqua panel #CDEDEA with a crisp water splash swirling at the base
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, the complete skincare set arranged as a group. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Group shot at a slight 3/4 angle, eye-level, all pieces fully visible and upright, a crisp water splash swirling around the base of the set. Bright soft cool-toned studio lighting with a front key and gentle fill, soft contact shadows grounding each piece. Light aqua background #CDEDEA. The product group occupies 60-70% of the frame centered on the vertical axis, and the splash and aqua field close the composition so the frame reads as one complete balanced packshot. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no hands, no duplicated product pieces, no floating products, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传递核心补水利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slightly low angle looking upward, set arranged on the left side
shots.lighting: bright soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow
shots.background: light aqua #CDEDEA with a soft water ripple along the bottom
shots.props: two to three translucent rounded bubbles
shots.textZone: right side one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1F6E6B with short bubble labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The set photographed from a slightly low angle looking upward, arranged on the left side and filling 50-60% of the frame. The right side carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1F6E6B, with two or three small translucent rounded bubbles holding short labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, so text and product balance into one complete composition. Light aqua background #CDEDEA with a soft water ripple along the bottom, bright soft front-left key light, soft contact shadow. Negative: no more than one core claim, no dense body text, no invented efficacy claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大干燥粗糙、缺水引发的肌肤问题，制造改变动机
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, straight-on frontal view identical on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat harsh light feeling dry and heavy; right panel soft gentle light
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 / 「{callout_2}」 in #1F6E6B
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical framing and lighting. Left panel: an abstract macro of dry, cracked, flaky skin texture under flat harsh light, conveying dehydration and roughness without showing a real face. Right panel: an abstract macro of smooth hydrated skin texture beside {product} softly lit, the product occupying 50-60% of that panel. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on frontal framing on both panels. Background pure white #FFFFFF on both panels. Each panel carries one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #1F6E6B, and the matched panel edges with a thin center divider close the layout so the frame reads as one finished split composition. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated statistics, no invented claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入真实晨间护理场景，让买家自我投射水润日常
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level, candid handheld feel over a bathroom vanity
shots.lighting: natural window light from the left, 5500K, faint water mist, soft contact shadows
shots.background: bright ceramic bathroom vanity #E8F1EF with soft morning light
shots.props: a folded towel and a small ceramic tray, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} arranged on a bright ceramic bathroom vanity #E8F1EF with soft morning light and a faint water mist. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel, the product occupying 40-50% of the frame. Natural window light from the left, 5500K, gentle mist, soft contact shadows. Props: a folded towel and a small ceramic tray, not covering the product. The vanity surface and the towel and tray fill the rest of the frame, so the scene reads as one complete morning composition with natural breathing margins. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered background.

shots.intent: 用清透水润的膏体质地微距证明配方质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high top-down close angle, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing glossy translucent texture
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the fresh gel-cream texture scooped beside the open jar of {product}, tight zoom on the glossy translucent surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot from a high top-down close angle with shallow depth of field, foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the bouncy gel texture and tiny air bubbles. Neutral light aqua surface background #DFF2EF. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace, the detail is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no fake texture, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands.

shots.intent: 讲清保湿成分与套装构成，消除成分与规格疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadows
shots.props: three rounded label cards with thin-line icons
shots.textZone: right column stacked rounded info cards: 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 in #1F6E6B with thin-line icons in #56C2A8
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, the set arranged neatly with one hero piece centered. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadows. Background light aqua #CDEDEA. Two-column layout: the product group on the left, and on the right three rounded info cards stacked in a column, each carrying one short line 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」 in #1F6E6B with a thin-line icon in #56C2A8, so the cards and product compose one complete balanced layout. The product and cards together occupy 60-70% of the frame with even aqua margins. Negative: no tiny unreadable text, no invented ingredients or certifications, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 按步骤拆解整套用法，让买家看懂一整套怎么用

Numbered circles 1 to 6 in #1F6E6B with thin-line icons, each step row carrying one short label 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」, so the numbered rows and product pieces compose one complete readable routine layout. The product pieces occupy 65-75% of the frame overall with tight even margins. shots.intent: 整套合体收口促单，优惠主张与行动引导直接入图

provenance.notes: 从 7 张爆款补水护肤套装详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字、模特面部、原文案、价格、会员二维码与水印；旧版信任镜的空徽章占位改为泵头工艺与啫喱质感的可验证呈现；产品一律以 {product} 占位，可复用于任意六件套补水保湿水乳套装。
